messages:
Meera: Quick heads-up — I need a short‑notice primary swap for tonight's 18:00-00:00 UTC block. Alex just pinged me, emergency IRL. Can someone cover primary starting ~18:30 UTC?

Alex: I'm on a call that won't finish. Sorry for the late notice, team. I'll hand over everything in the next 10. Key things: we're in mitigation for the us‑west latency spikes tied to the embeddings batcher.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager assigned: INC-2026 -> Alex (primary). Severity: P2. Symptom: sustained 5xx for text-generation endpoints in us-west-2.

Meera: Alex — quick checklist in the thread pls (runbooks, what to run, hotspots). Jon/Tara — can you confirm availability? If neither can, we'll escalate to the weekend rotation backup.

Alex: Copy. Passing to Jon ideally. Notes below:
- Current mitigation: pinned model to `redwood/gptx-1.2-quant`, disabled autoscale burst for replicas to avoid noisy noisy OOMs.
- Temporary knob: increase RPC retry to 3, backoff 250ms.
- Hotspot: batcher queue latency spikes on /var/log/serving/batcher.log (see snippet).

```
# quick commands
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-serving
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/serving-batcher -c batcher --tail=200
curl -s https://internal-metrics.us-west-2.redwood/serving | jq '.queues'
```

Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency (section: "batcher overload -> pin model -> roll back batch size")

Alex: I'm handing over primary at 18:30 UTC. Will leave a pinned note in PagerDuty and the incident channel. If anything escalates, tag me @alex and I'll triage remotely.

Jon: I can take primary starting 18:30. Confirming: I will accept the pager, put Tara as shadow for first 30m. Tara — can you shadow and own customer comms if needed?

Tara: Yep, I can shadow 18:30-19:00. I'll monitor SLO dashboards and take the first customer DM if it surfaces.

Meera: Thanks — plan looks good. Quick handoff protocol: 1) Jon takes PagerDuty; 2) Alex updates the incident header with current mitigations; 3) Tara subscribes to traces and the ticket; 4) Meera will be available as escalation to Eng leads.

Jon: Taking the pager now (will ack at 18:30). My immediate action on ack: check batcher logs, confirm pinned model, roll back batch size only if latency increases >2x.

sre-rotation: Rotation update: Alex -> Jon (primary), Tara -> shadow. Calendar updated for tonight 18:30-00:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: at 18:20 UTC a short checklist DM will be sent to Jon and Tara (runbook links + quick commands).

Meera: Small coverage gap note — if we see correlated errors across regions, do not failover traffic automatically; prefer model-variant fallback in the routing policy. Alex, leave the current routing policy in: `prefer: model-variant:v1.2-quant, fallback: v1.1-raw`.

Alex: Added routing policy to incident header. Also left a temp playbook snippet in the runbook: increase KV cache TTL to 300s if cold-starts spike.

Jon: Ack. I'll keep the team posted in this thread and will ping if I need escalation. Thanks for quick handover. :thumbsup:

Tara: I'll watch customer channels and the SLO dashboard. If anything customer-visible pops up, I'll DM the CS lead and post a short summary here.

Meera: All set. Closing handoff — Jon is primary, Tara shadows, Alex on-call but unavailable until 20:00 UTC. Please @me if any customer-facing notes are needed.

Jon: Confirmed primary takeover at 18:30 UTC.

oncall-bot: Pager update: INC-2026 reassigned to Jon at 18:30 UTC.

Meera: Thank you all. Leaving final note: if the batcher errors persist after rolling back batch size, escalate to runtime eng (tag eng-runtime) and consider a short canary rollback to pre-quant model (v1.1) for 30m.

Alex: Thanks team — appreciate the coverage. I'll try to remain reachable but handing primary off now.

Tara: standing by. :eyes:
